_comment: Licence allowlist for shipped dependencies. Spectra itself is Apache-2.0. Copyleft is not allowed without an exception; an exception is only 'approved' by the owner, never by tooling.

exceptions.reason: GPL-2.0-only. Since ADR-011 scapy is NOT a core dependency: it is only the optional 'live' extra (live NIC capture) and a dev/test dependency (packet builders, differential test). The wheel's core Requires-Dist, the container image and the offline pcap path do not contain or import it. Whoever installs spectra[live] takes scapy under its own licence; Spectra's Apache-2.0 distribution does not bundle it. The owner has not signed off the extra: that stays an owner call.
